description: The ACUMEN multimodal incentives project implements a transport optimisation model studying how a limited incentive budget can shift travellers from private cars to public transport or Park-and-Ride. Zenodo archives a named commit of the incentives-multimodal-Helsinki GitHub repository in one ZIP, freely under CC BY 4.0. The record covers that concrete software model, not evidence that a city implemented the incentives. Coverage is the Helsinki-labelled study; geographical zones, scenario dates, behavioural parameters, budget units and calibration data are not specified in the native description. The related ACUMEN passenger-estimation models address observation processing and are not assumed to be inputs to this model. A limitation is that the source does not report validated mode-shift effects. The code archive was not opened, dependencies were not installed and optimisation results were not reproduced.
